name: subvocal
description: Fewer thinking tokens, same answers. One measured instruction keeps a model's internal reasoning concise; the reply is unchanged. The strict shorthand dialect stays opt-in.

hooks.command: command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; HOOK_ROOT=$(printf %s "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" | sed 's|^/\([a-zA-Z]\)/|\1:/|'); node "$HOOK_ROOT/src/hooks/subvocal-activate.js"
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; HOOK_ROOT=$(printf %s "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" | sed 's|^/\([a-zA-Z]\)/|\1:/|'); node "$HOOK_ROOT/src/hooks/subvocal-activate.js" --subagent
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; HOOK_ROOT=$(printf %s "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" | sed 's|^/\([a-zA-Z]\)/|\1:/|'); node "$HOOK_ROOT/src/hooks/subvocal-mode-tracker.js"
